scope: Targeted SYS-1/2/3 server verification only; no production edits or broad suite
verdict: Below bar: original server defects fixed, one remaining round-attribution failure; retention UI verification pending
scoreExplanation: Substantial improvement from r1 6.8. Resource restoration, bound identity and recoverable transport loss now work. An accepted identity-change path can still invalidate the entire round. Retention is ungraded in this pass because the interface is changing and no fresh browser inspection was requested/performed.

originalDefects.evidence: Parent real-socket regression preserved damaged and dead state, cooldown, protection, damage timestamp, position and weapon with no new spawn. Independent live-tick transport-loss reconnect retained dead state, health=0, energy=7 and kills=4; no immediate respawn.
Both parent and independent probes rejected a different profile token on a participating socket; counters and identity unchanged.

Transport loss preserves an empty room during grace; independent live-tick probe confirmed time/tick/round stopped. Rejoin retained stats and canceled old expiry. Parent regression verified abandoned-room expiration. Explicit client namespace disconnect and independent server namespace disconnect remove sole-human room immediately.
originalDefects.semantics: Default reconnectGraceMs is 30000 by source inspection; tests use 250/350ms to exercise the same timer path. The leave event and client/server namespace disconnect are intentional exits with immediate cleanup when empty. Transport loss gets grace; empty rooms pause. Not all forms of disconnect promise recovery.

originalDefects.evidence: Current Interface.js resolves recap by player.profileId before socket fallback. No fresh intermission reconnect UI test in this pass.

defects.title: Explicit leave then identity change on the same socket invalidates the completed round
reproduction: Create a two-human room with bots disabled and stable tokens A and B. Keep B connected.
Give A round stats (probe fixture: four kills). Wait past the 400ms join throttle.
A emits leave without closing its Socket.IO connection. Join the same room on that socket with a different valid profile token C. Server accepts it.
End the round; allow the real server tick/event/persistence path to process roundEnd.

observed.serverLog: Ranking save failed: Duplicate player socket id
observed.clientEvent: Last round records could not be saved.

defects.cause: Departed A remains keyed by its old socket ID. C reuses that same socket ID; the recap concatenates departed/live participants. RankingStore correctly refuses the duplicate, so no participant receives the round. This follows the new error message instruction to leave before changing identity.
defects.impact: One accepted protocol sequence prevents recording the round for every human, including the unaffected opponent. Normal UI Leave may disconnect the socket; this is a real accepted socket-API edge case, not a demonstrated ordinary UI flow.
defects.recommendation: Reject identity reuse when that socket already represents a different departed participant in the current round, or use unique participation identities while preserving both profiles and winner mapping. Do not discard the departed record or merely remove RankingStore validation.
defects.regression: Two humans; A emits leave then same-socket join under C. Require either a clear safe rejection or a valid completed round with A/B/C credited once and distinct participant IDs.
